description: Pre-specified paired hard-oracle attribution contrasts. Every delta is left minus right within the same training seed.

contrasts.name: oracle_increment_within_care
contrasts.definition: Increment from hard-oracle CE inside the CARE configuration.

contrasts.name: oracle_increment_within_gkd
contrasts.definition: Increment from the same hard-oracle CE inside the full-response GKD configuration.

contrasts.name: localized_package_without_oracle
contrasts.definition: CARE package versus GKD when neither receives hard-oracle CE.

contrasts.name: localized_package_with_matched_oracle
contrasts.definition: CARE package versus GKD when both receive hard-oracle CE weight 0.25.

contrasts.name: oracle_only_sufficiency
contrasts.definition: Localized on-policy hard-oracle CE alone versus full-response GKD; a sufficiency control, not a single-switch causal pair.
